sources.title: LFM2.5 230M | Model Library | Overmind
sources.snippet: LFM2.5 230M trains on your agent's own traces with LoRA adapters or full finetuning, is benchmarked against your production model before any traffic moves, and serves through the same OpenAI-compatible API as every Overmind model. The final weights are yours to download and run anywhere.
